scope: Task-only loopback HTTP/CONNECT refusal setup and commands for root to execute later in the same dedicated persistent browser profile. No browser launch/profile modification/public request or qualification performed.

tool.actualChromeArgumentAndCanaryValidation: Required during root run; not claimed by help inspection.

proxy.requestLogging: Bounded timestamp, sequence, method allowlist, sanitized host and status; excludes userinfo, paths, queries, headers and bodies.
proxy.logCapBehavior: Further requests still refused; no further event records.
proxy.outputOverwrite: Refused for existing events or ready file.

validation.scope: Loopback socket server/client only. Request tests forbid socket.create_connection and getaddrinfo calls. All test servers/threads closed. Initial and final passing logs retained; final source whitelists logged methods.
validation.browserHelperSyntax: Both JS helper files passed node --check; never browser-executed.

browserProcedure.startsWith: Root verifies final public/frozen artifact and prepares actual real worker/save online.
browserProcedure.coldRestart: Verify exact old browser PID/CDP endpoint exits, relaunch new browser PID/CDP endpoint with same profile through live refusal proxy.
browserProcedure.networkOracle: Actual launch proxy flags + fresh outside-cache canaries with matching proxy refusals + service-worker response/controller/UI verification. navigator.onLine is not an oracle.
browserProcedure.cacheOracle: Product worker strips query strings; use a new unlisted pathname outside release scope for uncached negative probe.
browserProcedure.saveChannel: Derive exact build-info.version; release-0.57.0 and release-v0.57.0 are distinct. No version normalization.
browserProcedure.restore: Close only owned refused browser, stop only owned proxy after browser exit, relaunch same profile with clean online launch arguments/environment; no data reset.

notClaimed: All protocols or DNS globally blocked
Native saved flight/worker/readiness/cut outcome before root executes
